clauses.scope_note: Section 12, Changes to these terms; applies to continued access to the Services after updated Terms are posted or notice is given. If Customer does not accept the updated Terms, it must stop using the Services.
clauses.condition_explanation: updated_terms_posted_or_notice_given means Anthropic has posted updated Terms on its website or otherwise given notice of changes. customer_accepts_updated_terms means Customer accepts those updated Terms; continued access constitutes agreement under the paragraph.

obligation_items.content: Stop using the Services if Customer does not accept the updated Terms.
obligation_items.trigger: Anthropic posts updated Terms or gives notice of changes, and Customer does not accept them.

clauses.scope_note: Section 12, Supplemental terms; applies when using a Service subject to guidelines, rules, or supplemental terms posted on the Services. Supplemental Terms govern over conflicting Terms for the applicable Service.
clauses.condition_explanation: applicable_supplemental_terms_exist means applicable guidelines, rules, or supplemental terms have been posted on the Services. comply_with_applicable_supplemental_terms means Customer follows them when using the applicable Service.

obligation_items.content: Comply with applicable guidelines, rules, and supplemental terms posted on the Services.
obligation_items.object: Applicable Service and its applicable Supplemental Terms
obligation_items.trigger: Customer uses a Service for which applicable Supplemental Terms have been posted.

clauses.scope_note: Section 12, Termination; Anthropic may suspend or terminate Customer’s access, including Subscriptions, at any time without notice if it believes Customer breached the Terms or must act to comply with law. The paragraph also permits termination of a Subscription for any other reason, with a pro-rata refund of remaining website-purchased subscription fees; App Distributor refunds are governed by that distributor’s terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: anthropic_believes_customer_breached_terms_or_termination_required_by_law means Anthropic believes there has been a breach or determines termination is necessary to comply with law. subscription_terminated_for_other_reason means Anthropic terminates a Subscription for a reason other than those grounds. The source authorizes termination; it does not require it.

clauses.scope_note: Section 12, Termination; Customer may stop accessing the Services at any time.
clauses.condition_explanation: No condition is specified for Customer stopping access.

clauses.scope_note: Section 12, Termination; Anthropic may terminate an Account for inactivity only if the Account has been inactive for over a year and is not paid. Anthropic must give notice before terminating on this ground.
clauses.condition_explanation: inactive_over_one_year_and_no_paid_account means both that the Account has been inactive for more than one year and that it is not a paid Account.

obligation_items.content: Provide notice before terminating the Account for inactivity.
obligation_items.trigger: Anthropic terminates an Account because it has been inactive for over a year and does not have a paid Account.

clauses.scope_note: Section 12, Termination; after termination of the Terms, a Subscription, or access to the Services, Anthropic may, at its option, delete Materials or other data associated with the Account.
clauses.condition_explanation: terms_subscription_or_access_terminated means any of the Terms, a Subscription, or Customer’s access to the Services has terminated. The paragraph permits deletion but does not require it.

clauses.scope_note: Section 12, No assignment; Customer may not transfer or assign the Terms without Anthropic’s prior written consent. This is an agreement-assignment restriction, not a general rule about sublicensing Service materials.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_transfers_or_assigns_terms means Customer proposes to transfer or assign the Terms. prior_written_anthropic_consent means Anthropic has consented in writing beforehand.

obligation_items.content: Do not transfer or assign the Terms without Anthropic’s prior written consent.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Customer proposes to transfer or assign the Terms; the prohibition does not apply if Anthropic has first given written consent.

clauses.scope_note: Section 12, Use of our brand; restricts use of Anthropic’s name, logos, or other trademarks in connection with products or services other than the Services, or in any other way implying Anthropic affiliation, endorsement, or sponsorship. Prior written permission is an exception.
clauses.condition_explanation: use_anthropic_name_logo_or_trademark_outside_services_or_implying_affiliation_endorsement_or_sponsorship means either use in connection with products or services other than the Services or use in any manner implying affiliation, endorsement, or sponsorship. prior_written_anthropic_permission means Anthropic has granted written permission before the use.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Anthropic’s name, logos, or other trademarks in a covered manner without prior written permission.
obligation_items.object: Anthropic’s name, logos, and other trademarks
obligation_items.trigger: Customer proposes a use in connection with products or services other than the Services, or any use implying Anthropic affiliation, endorsement, or sponsorship; no prohibition applies to that use if Anthropic has given prior written permission.

clauses.scope_note: Section 12, Export Controls; Customer may not export or provide access to the Services into U.S.-embargoed countries or to persons or entities on the listed U.S. or other restricted-party lists. Customer also represents that it and anyone accessing or using the Services on its behalf or using its Account credentials are not such persons or entities and are not located in such a country.
clauses.condition_explanation: recipient_or_destination_is_embargoed_or_restricted means the destination is a U.S.-embargoed country or the recipient is on the U.S. Treasury Specially Designated Nationals list, another OFAC restricted-party list, the U.S. Commerce Denied Persons List or Entity List, or another restricted-party list.

obligation_items.content: Do not export or provide access to the Services into a U.S.-embargoed country or to anyone on a specified restricted-party list.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever Customer exports the Services or provides access to them; the restriction applies to the listed destinations and recipients.

obligation_items.content: Represent that Customer and anyone accessing or using the Services on Customer’s behalf, or using Customer’s Account credentials, are not restricted persons or entities and are not located in a restricted country.
obligation_items.object: Customer, persons accessing or using the Services on Customer’s behalf, and persons using Customer’s Account credentials
obligation_items.trigger: Customer’s representation under the Export Controls paragraph.

clauses.scope_note: Section 12, Legal Compliance; Anthropic may comply with governmental, court, and law-enforcement requests or requirements relating to provision or use of the Services or information provided to or collected under the Terms, and reserves discretion to report information from or about Customer, including Inputs, Outputs, or Actions, to law enforcement.
clauses.condition_explanation: governmental_court_or_law_enforcement_request_or_requirement_or_anthropic_elects_to_report covers the stated request or requirement, or Anthropic’s discretionary decision to report information to law enforcement. The text grants discretion; it does not require reporting.

clauses.scope_note: Section 12, U.S. Government Use; U.S. Government users of the Services have only the rights granted to all other end users under the Terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: actor_is_us_government_user means the Services are used by a U.S. Government user. rights_granted_to_all_other_end_users_under_terms refers to the rights actually granted under the Terms; this paragraph does not create an additional grant.

coverage_notes: Sections 3, 6, 9–12 and other incorporated documents may affect use or survive termination, but their full operative text is not present in this target chunk; no missing rules have been inferred.

The export clause uses the allowed ProvideNetworkService activity as the closest available representation of providing access to a service; its scope is limited to the stated export/access restriction.
The brand clause’s trademark object and the agreement-assignment object have no dedicated object enum; OriginalArtifact is used with the precise identities stated in scope_note.
The dispute-resolution paragraph concerns remedies, governing law, and venue rather than an activity constraint and is treated as nonoperative for this extraction.

paragraph_audit.reason: Extracts the operative continued-use condition, supplemental-term duty, termination and deletion provisions, assignment and brand restrictions, export/access restriction and representation, discretionary disclosure, and government-user rights boundary.
The paragraph addresses equitable remedies for breach of Section 3 and governing law, courts, and jurisdiction; it imposes no activity constraint represented by the allowed activities and objects.
